name: AA battery
headline: height
subtitle: Energizer E91 alkaline AA (IEC LR6)
description: The AA is a common cylindrical battery size, designated LR6 by the IEC and 15A by ANSI in its alkaline form. Energizer's datasheet for its E91 alkaline AA gives industry-standard dimensions of 49.50 to 50.50 mm tall and 13.50 to 14.50 mm across. A typical cell weighs 23.0 g and delivers a nominal 1.5 volts.

measures.label: Overall height
measures.note: Industry standard dimension limits, 49.50 (1.949 in) to 50.50 mm (1.988 in)

measures.label: Diameter
measures.note: Industry standard dimension limits, 13.50 (0.531 in) to 14.50 mm (0.571 in)

measures.label: Weight
measures.note: Typical weight of an Energizer E91 (0.8 oz)

measures.label: Volume
measures.note: Typical volume of an Energizer E91 (0.5 cubic inch)

facts.text: The E91 uses a zinc-manganese dioxide alkaline chemistry with a nominal voltage of 1.5 volts.
Energizer rates the E91's shelf life at 10 years at 21 °C.

sources.title: Energizer E91 AA Product Datasheet (Form No. E91NA1018)

caveats: Weight and volume are for the Energizer E91 alkaline cell only; other brands and chemistries were not checked.
Height and diameter are the minimum and maximum limits shown on the datasheet's industry-standard dimension drawing.
